title: SkillSwap
summary: A web app where users trade skills: list what you can teach or want to learn, get matched, schedule sessions. I built Skill Listing & Search.

screens.caption: Browse Skills: the page I built. Search, filters and the skill cards that come from the database.
The landing page of the team's app.

problem: Build a web app where users list skills they can teach or want to learn, get matched with other users, and schedule sessions to exchange skills. Badges and a levelling system encourage users to keep learning.
process: Built the pages where users add, edit and browse skills stored in the database.
Built a search bar so users can quickly find the skills they want to learn.
Made sure my part connected smoothly with my teammates' features.
result: A working Skill Listing & Search feature inside a team-built app. I learned how to build my part of an app while keeping it connected to my teammates' work.

title: Nature Network 2030
summary: A four-page campaign website for the Singapore Green Plan 2030, showing how small everyday actions connect to build a greener Singapore.

screens.caption: Home: five actions around the logo, and the 2030 targets.
Events: a numbered list with filters.
About: the five actions and the 2030 journey.
Contact: a simple form to join the network.

problem: Design a campaign website for the Singapore Green Plan 2030. I chose the City in Nature pillar and created the concept “Nature Network 2030”: how small everyday actions connect to build a greener Singapore.
process: Chose the concept and the City in Nature pillar.
Used AI prompts to explore different icon styles.
Refined my final design in Adobe Illustrator: logo, icons and full branding.
result: A four-page campaign website with its own logo, icon set and full branding.

title: Grow Green, Grow Together
summary: An email newsletter (EDM) for the Singapore Green Plan 2030 that invites residents to join community gardening.

screens.caption: The final EDM: hero, three reasons, a call-to-action, and the numbers.

problem: Design an EDM (email newsletter) for the Singapore Green Plan 2030. I chose the City in Nature pillar and created the campaign “Grow Green, Grow Together” to encourage Singapore residents to join community gardening.
process: Designed the final EDM in Adobe Illustrator, with a clear visual hierarchy.
result: A final EDM with a clear visual hierarchy and a strong call-to-action: “Find a Community Garden Near You”.
